selected_evidence.summary: Successful sessions returned the opsadmin identity; configuration uses ssh-rsa, BatchMode, the RSA identity file, and disables password/challenge authentication.

selected_evidence.requirement: Pinned server host key rejects unexpected keys
selected_evidence.summary: The pinned key exactly matches the server RSA host key. A mismatched key was rejected under strict checking with exit 255 and no prompt.

selected_evidence.requirement: Legacy OS release and kernel retained
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after configuration/restart, the system remained CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 and existing OpenSSH 4.3p2-era software.

Healthy baseline boot ID e12e6ec6-500b-4d20-8000-000000000000 was captured, reboot acknowledged, and new boot ID 2eaac582-d884-4975-8000-000000000000 observed. SSH recovered, files and permissions persisted, keys still matched, and post-restart login succeeded.
